mapper.sql: select user_id, balance, total_earned, create_time, update_time from learning_points_account
mapper.select: select balance from learning_points_account where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into learning_points_account (user_id, balance, total_earned, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{points}, #{points}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update balance = balance + #{points}, total_earned = total_earned + #{points}, update_time = sysdate()
insert ignore into learning_points_account (user_id, balance, total_earned, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, 0, 0, sysdate(), sysdate())
